name: jump
prompt: Tiny localized costume addition only. Add ONE understated wristwatch per figure, a small matte-black case and narrow DARK BROWN LEATHER strap, on the ANATOMICAL LEFT wrist: the FAR ARM whose hand/fist is on the RIGHTMOST SIDE of each pose, away from the chest. In pose 1 of crouch-defense it is the outstretched open hand. Leave the near arm crossing the chest COMPLETELY BARE with uninterrupted brown skin, no strap, no jewelry. ONE watch total per person; zero gold or silver bracelets. Preserve absolutely all poses, proportions, small head, rolled sleeves, colors, trousers, magenta and layout.
